in_sanskrit.name: आयनेश
in_sanskrit.meaning: Lord of the breath or Prana
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the ruler of Prana or the vital energy. Ayanesh is also considered as the presiding deity of knowledge, wisdom and intellect. He is also known as the god of horses and the giver of good fortune.

in_marathi.name: Ayanesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Axis
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ayanesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ayanesh is the deity of the north, the lord of the axis, the one who holds the universe in place. In Hindu mythology, he is the preserver of the world and the god of fertility.
